messages:
anna.runtime: Heads up — around 17:48 UTC we saw a ~3x tail latency bump on shared-gpu-pool-7. Starts as tiny (~50ms) then jumps to 1800-2200ms for ~30s. Sampled traces point at kernel-selection churn + a KV cache misswave. @kevin_perf can you take a look?
kevin_perf: on it. grabbing perf traces and a flamegraph. noticed kernel switch logs aligning with KV eviction spikes. will post artifacts.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 (auto). Paging on-call.
leo_infra: tagging in. I see pool-7 had a sudden influx from tenant:alpha-bench (burst tokens enabled). Could be priority inversion between long-seq jobs and short-chat requests.
maya_sre: alpha-bench has a warmup job that ramps token throughput; they recently increased burst cap to 4x. Could evict KV entries.
kevin_perf: uploaded flamegraph: https://internal.artifacts/flamegraphs/1758882222-alpha-kv-flame.svg — big hotspots around kv_lookup -> kernel_select -> compile_path. Also kernel switch traces show toggles between quant-path and fp16-path every ~120ms.
anna.runtime: showing kernel_select logs here (sanitized):
```
[17:48:02.112] pool7 kernel_select: preferred=quant-path seq_len=64 batch=12
[17:48:02.234] pool7 kernel_select: preferred=fp16-path seq_len=512 batch=1
[17:48:02.338] pool7 kernel_switch: policy=autoswitch reason=batch_distortion
[17:48:02.412] kvcache: evict tenant_slot=0x3f reason=slot_pressure
```
kevin_perf: core problem looks like correlated events: alpha-bench sends many long-seq requests causing small batches but long KV traces, which reduces effective batch sizes for other tenants; kernel autoswitch heuristics interpret distribution shift and swap kernels frequently. That swap path has a memory touch + JIT/stub overhead ~300-600ms per swap.
leo_infra: so noisy neighbor causes kernel churn -> extra CPU/GPU work -> longer latencies for everyone. KV evictions make long-seq tenants re-populate KV causing more pressure. Vicious cycle.
maya_sre: any quick mitigations? Can we pin kernels per model or increase hysteresis threshold for kernel autoswitch on pool-7?
kevin_perf: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle alpha-bench bursts (reduce burst cap) 2) temporarily pin popular models to quant-path on pool-7 3) raise kernel-autoswitch cooldown (config knob: kernel.autoswitch.cooldown_ms) from 100ms -> 5s 4) enforce per-tenant KV quota to prevent large-slot storms.
anna.runtime: let's do (1) + (3) now. @leo_infra can you apply a temporary quota to alpha-bench and bump cooldown? I'll open a rollout.
leo_infra: applying throttle: `rbctl tenants update alpha-bench --burst-cap 1.2x` and setting cooldown: `rbctl pools update pool-7 --kernel-autoswitch-cooldown-ms 5000` — rolling these to pool-7 nodes now.
sre-bot: Deploy job #deploy-824 applied to pool-7 (3 nodes). Health checks passing.
kevin_perf: re-running perf capture. Preliminary numbers: tail latency back to baseline within ~6s after rollout, no more frequent kernel_switch logs. KV miss rate dropped 45%.
maya_sre: good. we should still cap long-seq jobs in shared pools long-term. Recommendation: create a pool tier for heavy long-seq workloads (dedicated) and tighten autoswitch hysteresis globally.
kevin_perf: also found one regress commit in autoswitch heuristic: commit 6a3f9d removed a max-cooldown safeguard. Reverting that change prevents pathological flip on bimodal batch distributions.
anna.runtime: opened a follow-up RFC: "Dedicated long-seq pool + autoswitch safeguards" and a PR to revert 6a3f9d. Putting a temporary rule: any tenant with >50% long-seq traffic flagged for review and recommended to move to dedicated.
leo_infra: I'll create an alert: "pool.kernel-churn" that triggers on >N kernel_switch events per 60s. Also add KV eviction rate alert per-tenant.
maya_sre: postmortem draft: short incident summary, root cause (noisy tenant + autoswitch cooldown regression + KV eviction storm), mitigations (throttle, cooldown bump, revert commit), and long-term actions.
kevin_perf: attaching perf traces and the exact commands used to reproduce in staging:
```
# generate long-seq workload
python tools/loadgen.py --tenant alpha-bench --seq-len 512 --rps 60 --burst 400
# collect perf
rbctl trace collect --pool pool-7 --duration 30s --out /tmp/trace.pb
flamegraph /tmp/trace.pb > /tmp/fg.svg
```
anna.runtime: thanks all. I'll run the RFC and schedule a review with runtime + infra + SRE. Filing postmortem and tagging relevant product folks about tenancy guidance. :thumbsup:
kevin_perf: I'll follow up on reverting commit + tests to ensure cooldown cannot be removed.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 updated: mitigated, monitoring established, owner=anna.runtime."
